more_info.overview: Ammonium stearate is the ammonium salt of stearic acid. It can be prepared by reacting stearic acid with ammonium carbonate or ammonium hydroxide. The fatty-acid salt is chemically different from magnesium, calcium or aluminium stearate. The dataset retains a historical anti-caking classification, while a current human-food example for the exact preparation was not confirmed.
